chart.description: Max, min, and total cost usage by service
chart.name: Cost overview by service
chart.programText:
A = histogram('gen_ai.usage.cost', filter=filter('gen_ai.system', 'langchain')).sum(by=['service.name']).above(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='A')
B = histogram('gen_ai.usage.cost', filter=filter('gen_ai.system', 'langchain')).min(by=['service.name']).above(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='B')
C = histogram('gen_ai.usage.cost', filter=filter('gen_ai.system', 'langchain')).max(by=['service.name']).above(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='C')
